summary: Mule deer doe attacked a woman walking two leashed dogs in the South Rim Campground, knocking her down and trampling her, causing life-threatening injuries; campground hosts and visitors drove the deer off; park rangers controlled her bleeding and stabilized her; she went by ambulance to a hospital for surgery and was expected to make a full recovery; CPW officers later shot the deer after it charged them.
location: South Rim Campground, Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP
responding_agency: NPS Black Canyon rangers; local EMS/ambulance; Colorado Parks and Wildlife officers
notes: NPS morning-report entry dated 2015-07-09. Deer was likely protecting a newborn fawn; prior minor dog-related incidents preceded the attack.
